symptoms: Angioedema with severe airway obstruction / anaphylaxis

management_steps.details: Adults: 0.5 mL into the lateral thigh, administered immediately and repeated every 5 to 15 minutes as needed. Children: 0.01 mL/kg of 1:1000 solution, administered immediately (maximum dose of 0.3 mL).
Indicated in severe cases where airway obstruction is present.
